answer_1.quote: OBLIVIATE, an LLM unlearning framework that can effectively eliminate the influence of unlearning data while preserving the model's performance and fluency on the retain set.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates text responses to prompts, with evaluation on fluency, coherence, and suppression of memorized content.

answer_2.quote: We introduce a suite of metrics covering forget quality, model utility, and fluency.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o fluency scores for all datasets. To enhance evaluation robustness, we report averaged scores from five GPT-4o conversations using the same prompts/responses.
